# AI Science Tracker

> A catalog of 1190 entries about scientific results enabled by AI across 11 fields and 652 organizations since 2020. Each entry links to an original paper, preprint or institutional announcement. Entry counts are not counts of independent findings: methodological contributions can overlap other entries, and one entry can describe several related results. Figures are reported by the sources and are not independently verified; relevance scores are coarse editorial judgments, not evidence grades.

Content is licensed CC BY 4.0 (attribute "AI Science Tracker" with a link); site code is MIT. Model data comes from Epoch AI (CC BY 4.0). When citing a scientific claim, cite the original source linked on each entry, not this catalog.

## Browse
- [Discoveries](https://aisciencetracker.org/index.html): filters, charts and the full list
- [Organizations and model families](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/index.html): static profile pages
- [Model progress](https://aisciencetracker.org/model-progress.html): exact model comparison, ECI, benchmark evidence and recorded release rhythm
- [Search all collections](https://aisciencetracker.org/search.html): literal retrieval with separate counts and match reasons
- [Antibiotic evidence dossier](https://aisciencetracker.org/antibiotic-dossier.html): dated, source-bounded synthesis
- [Models](https://aisciencetracker.org/models.html): model releases linked to discoveries
- [Vuln discoveries](https://aisciencetracker.org/security.html): publicly disclosed vulnerabilities with documented AI involvement, kept separate from the scientific count
- [Methodology](https://aisciencetracker.org/methodology.html): what is included, how entries are verified and scored

## Data
- [discoveries.json](https://aisciencetracker.org/data/discoveries.json): active catalog entries (schema and counting unit: docs/discovery-schema.md in the repository)
- [models.json](https://aisciencetracker.org/data/models.json): model releases and families
- [model-progress.json](https://aisciencetracker.org/data/model-progress.json): separate Epoch capability/benchmark source entries; may overlap releases
- [vulnerabilities.json](https://aisciencetracker.org/data/vulnerabilities.json): vulnerability cases
- [sitemap.xml](https://aisciencetracker.org/sitemap.xml): every static page
- [dataset.html](https://aisciencetracker.org/dataset.html): downloads (JSON, CSV), schemas and the read-only static API at https://aisciencetracker.org/api/v1/index.json
- [contributors.html](https://aisciencetracker.org/contributors.html): maintainer, contributors and how to contribute
- [feed.xml](https://aisciencetracker.org/feed.xml): Atom feed of discovery additions and vulnerability source checks
- Each discovery has its own page at https://aisciencetracker.org/share/ID.html

## Notes
- Most recent catalog addition: 2026-11-17. This is not a last-review date.
- The collection is manual and not exhaustive; most sources are the announcing organizations' own pages.
- Repository: https://github.com/marcello-pichini/ai-science-tracker
